annotations.text: wireframes — one desktop (1440) and one mobile (390) artboard per Phase 0 page type in plan/05 §1–§2, in the approved system, laid out in buyer-journey order. Round 2 (TASK-059, 2026-09-09): every page reworked against the competitor study in docs/design/benchmarks/ — products and all-in prices before prose, the fee printed on every date chip, cutoffs in the recipient's time zone, and first-person copy throughout (spec 004 §14 A5). Heights are measured from a real render, not estimated.
